findings.text: All 9 fixed public phase hosts passed with receiver+local History verifier under cpu.max 25000 100000 and 2 GiB; external actors/controller under cpu.max 400000 100000. Former e25 PUBLIC_HOST_KERNEL_PARENT startup failure is not this run outcome. Host setup success does not imply service acceptance.

findings.certainty: all retained samples/final accounting and phase outcome
findings.text: No genuine depletion observed in 6 attack phases, no terminal mutation CPU budget refusal; sampled paid credits remain approximately 1.98139-1.98288 CPU seconds. More than 4 CPU seconds were genuinely charged per attack phase, but credited wall-time refill nearly matches that debit. End-to-end pressure failed, without meeting required depletion antecedent. Discrete samples are not a continuous impossibility proof.

findings.certainty: actual original records and test control flow
findings.text: 0/27 predeclared confirmations; only first round observed in each phase and 18 later rounds unobserved. All 24 History transport responses arrived on time; 15 local imports succeeded and 9 failed with PUBLIC_REQUEST_DEADLINE, including every no-attacker baseline. No complete page, activation or local confirmation operation was reached.

findings.certainty: before/after native instrumentation differences plus source scope
findings.text: Per-import wall/thread CPU and existing nested stage observations locate a substantial measured cost in ordinary local History import and verify_state/account_graph. AccountGraph wraps full account-node traversal with SQL reads/decodes/graph checks and progress/resource callbacks. Not enough granularity to partition its wall time into CPU scheduling/throttle, I/O, filesystem Host verification, hashing and locks, or pinpoint the exact deadline checkpoint.

Server mutation_cpu_domain final flow and independent-client Node History CPU owner are separate accounts sharing one kernel quota. Parent-process CPU includes both plus setup/reactor/other work. Do not debit parent CPU to receiver budget, subtract it to allege unpaid work, infer per-request cost from phase totals, or add nested instrumentation.

source_logic.original_deadline: public_v3_multiprocess.rs:927-933 constructs one import_deadline just before 30-second epoch; reused for every page
source_logic.import_timing: public_v3_multiprocess.rs:1031-1055 stamps deserialize + receive_public_page_from_before, including current client thread only
source_logic.confirmation_gate: public_v3_multiprocess.rs:1057-1068 only calls confirmation when after == tip; 1116-1118 break on unconfirmed round
source_logic.exclusive_path: ingress.rs:2467-2498 → history_import::Owner::Exclusive, with fixed parent verification
source_logic.deadline_checks: history_import.rs Control::alive; control.check across CPU reservation, decode, W1, admission and activation. Generic error does not identify exact checkpoint.
source_logic.account_graph_scope: native_authenticated.rs:653-675 wraps verify_state, inner AccountGraph calls native_store::verify_with_lifts; native_store.rs:345-417 full graph traversal
source_logic.timing_semantics: history_arithmetic.rs:465-507 RAII elapsed wall/current-thread CPU counted on Drop including errors; stage intervals nest and are not additive

minimal_followup_design_only: Keep genuine depletion and honest service as two explicit independent verdicts; preserve original 27 confirmation denominator and 18 unobserved rounds.

Before optimization, retain these actual client import/stage baselines. Further diagnosis would need per-page or per-request stage correlation and scoped-worker/Host-check/SQL/throttling/lock timing, with original deadline and acceptance rules unchanged. No new instrumentation/run is implemented here.

Any account-graph traversal or checkpoint optimization must retain original full relation, owner provenance, current stored-byte integrity and deadline/resource enforcement. Existing aggregate hotspot does not authorize skipping checks or reusing prior validity as consensus authority.

Budget reachability remains conditional on receiver paid debit versus actual credited refill/reservations/settlement. This actual run closes neither depletion-under-service nor restart-credit/kill-cut/WAN/PQ obligations.
limits: This is one controlled host repeated three times; not independent administrators or WAN.
No actual kill cuts in the 144 attacker exits; cannot replace crash/restart no-credit-mint evidence.
Fresh initial 2s each phase is experimental initialization, not a restart-resumption test.
Client stage CPU excludes scoped workers; parent process time is another scope.
No proof that every possible real attack cannot deplete this budget; no arithmetic simulation is promoted to attack evidence.
